Package hadur2.core.role

Class RoleResolver

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.role.RoleResolver
public final class RoleResolver extends Object
Picks the role that drives each tick (ROLE-2 to ROLE-4), in place of the melee extension's posture gate. The choice itself is one pure function, resolve(int, int, int): the first row that holds wins.
  1. Team: the Team role is built and not vetoed, a teammate and an enemy are alive, and neither Melee nor Duel has driven this round. Until the Team strand exists the Team role is never built, so this row never holds.
  2. Melee (ROLE-3): the charter has the Melee role, it has not been vetoed this round, two or more enemies are alive, no sentry is, and the Duel has not driven this round.
  3. Duel: otherwise. The Duel is the floor and is never vetoed.

Once a role has driven in a round no role above it drives again that round (ROLE-4): that latch, not the counts, makes the role move only down, at most twice a round. Only a new round clears it, and a tick the Guard covers leaves it as it stands, because the core records the role that drove only when the tick completes (drove(hadur2.core.role.RoleId)).

The instance keeps what the function reads across ticks: the round's Melee veto (a scanned sentry, GATE-3, or a melee fault, GATE-4), the latch, and the sentry names, which are remembered for the whole battle so a sentry is never taken for an opponent once seen (GATE-5). Robocode already leaves sentries out of the count of others.

    • resolve

      public static RoleId resolve(Charter charter, int enemies, int teammates, int sentriesAlive, Veto meleeVeto, boolean teamVetoed, RoleId driven)
      ROLE-2: the role, from the charter, the counts of enemies, teammates and sentries alive, the round's vetoes and the lowest role that has driven this round, and from nothing else. Always answers; never answers a role above driven.
      Parameters:
      charter - the battle's charter
      enemies - enemies alive
      teammates - teammates alive
      sentriesAlive - sentries alive
      meleeVeto - the round's Melee veto
      teamVetoed - whether the Team role has faulted this round
      driven - the lowest role that has driven this round, or null
      Returns:
      the role that drives this tick
